_doc: Per-file line-coverage baselines (whole percent points) PLUS the excluded_files allowlist for source files that produce NO LCOV records (static-only modules, feature-gated tiers CI doesn't enable). Both lists are consulted by scripts/coverage_ratchet.py; every source file in crates/*/src/**/*.rs must appear in exactly one. See docs/COVERAGE.md.

excluded_files.crates/rostdown/src/arena.rs: behind rostdown's `arena` Cargo feature (scoped bump allocator; embedder opt-in) — default CI build excludes
excluded_files.crates/rubund/src/lib.rs: single-line `pub mod parser;` — no executable code
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs-jit/src/native.rs: behind rubyrs-jit's `native` Cargo feature — default CI build excludes
all `#[used] static` declarations — no executable lines for LCOV to instrument; closes the gap flagged on PR #274
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/aes.rs: behind the `_openssl` Cargo feature (AES cipher primitives); default CI build excludes (same shape as openssl.rs below)
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/bcrypt.rs: behind the `_bcrypt` Cargo feature (crypt_blowfish port); default CI build excludes
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/bcrypt_init.rs: static Blowfish P/S-box tables `include!`d by bcrypt.rs (itself `_bcrypt`-gated) — not a standalone module, no executable lines
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/commdrv.rs: behind the `_prism_native` Cargo feature (native RuboCop Commissioner cop-walk driver); default CI build excludes (same shape as jit_native above)
